Correct legacy FN2 date substitutions

correct_fn2creel_legacy_dates.Rd

Legacy FN2 creel projects conducted in 2000 or later may contain surrogate calendar years chosen to preserve weekday/weekend alignment. The true survey year is extracted from the project code (PRJ_CD; SCYY format) and used to replace the year component of all Date fields throughout the project.

Usage

correct_fn2creel_legacy_dates(x)

Arguments

x

A creel project object.

Value

A creel project object with corrected Date fields.

Details

The original imported year is preserved in FN011$FN2LEGACYYEAR.

Users of import_fn_creel1() or import_creel_series() do not normally need to call this function directly, as it is intended to be applied automatically during import.

Projects with survey years prior to 2000 are returned unchanged.

The original imported year is stored in FN011$FN2LEGACYYEAR. If this field already exists, the function assumes the project has previously been transformed and will stop with an error.

See also

import_fn_creel1, import_creel_series

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Normally called internally by import_fn_creel() and
# import_creel_series().
} # }
